title: Logarithmic-space class membership
statement: Let $P$ be an extended word RAM program, $L$ a language of Boolean strings, and $c,F_0$ natural numbers. Suppose that for every Boolean string $x$ there are a natural number $t$ and output string $o$ such that $P$, on $x$ with empty coin sequence and word width $c(\lfloor\log_2 |x|\rfloor+1)$, halts within $t$ steps and space $F_0$, returning the Boolean indicator of membership in $L$. Then $L$ belongs to logarithmic space.
